rows: THE USER 2026-11-03 ("make sure there is enough orichalcum spread throughout the game for synthesis (some bosses can drop it, can be found in chests, etc, but orichalcum must be a fixed item drop (never random) and there should be enough to craft everything"); package P13 ORE (documentation/KH3_WEAPONS_PLAN.md 3.1); recomputed from sheets/port/kh3-synthesis.json (every recipe once) + kh3-keyblade-levels.json (every Forge level a Keyblade lacks when obtained: none costs it)

Orichalcum (MAT_ITEM56) that crafting everything takes: IS_46 Orichalcum Ring x1, IS_47 Wisdom Ring x1, IS_55 Save the Queen x1, IS_56 Save the King x1, IS_57 Cosmic Chain x1, IS_59 Save the Queen+ x1, IS_60 Save the King+ x1, IS_69 Fire Chain x1, IS_70 Blizzard Chain x1, IS_71 Thunder Chain x1, IS_75 Aqua Chaplet x1, IS_76 Aero Armlet x1, IS_79 Dark Chain x1, IS_80 Petite Ribbon x2. No recipe makes it; KH3 sells none
crates/kh-host/tests/ore_budget.rs recomputes it and fails when this row or the placements fall behind
